channel: allcoredevs/_threads/Does it appear feasible to get Shorter
searchText: I'm just saying instead of pushing gas limit to 300m or higher as may be possible in Glamsterdam, maybe we instead do a more modest gas limit increase and reduce the slot time to 6s-8s in Hegotá. I think this is something the users of Ethereum really want to see. I do understand that lowering slot times raises the bar for other aspects of the roadmap, especially zkproving with lean Ethereum. However, I also think faster slot times will serve as a forcing function to encourage even more innovation to faster proving times on commodity GPUs. Fast Confirmation Rule is genius that it unlocked most or small transactions by relaxing certain security bonds. Now after ePBS, can slot time default to 6s but wait more when network fluctuates? In the past PoW did guarantee slot time
